description: This file defines the AttributeSyncFieldMappingService class responsible for synchronizing attribute fields with user data, including handling options and creating new attribute options as needed.

classes.name: AttributeSyncFieldMappingService
classes.description: Service class for syncing integration attribute fields to user attributes, managing options, and updating user attribute assignments.

methods.name: syncIntegrationFieldsToAttributes
methods.description: Main method to synchronize integration fields to user attributes, handling existing options and creating new ones if necessary.

methods.name: processMappings
methods.description: Processes enabled field mappings, matching integration values to attribute options or creating new options for text/number attributes.

methods.name: createOptionsAndGetAssignments
methods.description: Creates new attribute options in bulk and returns user assignments for these options.
